0.description: [Requires Restart] Reduced health of rares in Escape the Apocalypse event by 20%.
Fixed an issue where Twisted Fate is not removed from pets when leaving the Twisting Nether.
Killing players in the Twisting Nether will now remove 5 stacks of Twisted Fate

1.description: [Pending Restart] - Hand of Guldan is now available on Area-52!

7.description: [Pending Restart] - Demonic Persistence is now available on Area-52!

0.description: Fixed an issue where you could group on Escape from Apocalypse Twisting Nether map
[Requires Restart] Added additional Greedy Demon Spawn Locations to Twisting Nether
Doubled Drop Chances of Bloodforged gear for Max level felforged in the Open World.
Increased aggro radius on creatures in Twisting Nether.
Updated waypoints on various creatures in Twisting Nether.
Escape from the Apocalypse will now require a Fel Iron key to leave using Fel Gateways. These are obtained from killing rare monsters and other heroes.
[Requires Restart] Twisted Fate will now also affect pets
Fixed Life Drain tick rate on Ur'zul Fiend
[Requires Restart] Fixed problems with Creatures not respawning on Twisting Nether map.
Fixed issues with healing in the Twisting Nether Apocalypse map.

1.description: Fixed the tooltip of several spells related to Wild Imps from Hand of Guldan and specifically stated which talent affects the Wild Imps, and how they affect the Wild Imps.

[Pending Restart] - Hand of Guldan now summons 4 Wild Imps baseline, but Decimation now increases the number of Wild Imps by 1/2, down from 2/4. With this, the average number of Wild Imps throughout the fight is slightly increased. This simply shifts some of the power from execute to being stronger baseline, while also increasing its overall performance.
[Pending Restart] - Demonic Tactics will now also increase the critical strike chance of your Wild Imps.

7.description: [Pending Restart] - Demonic Persistence will now also add a 1 second duration increase to your Wild Imps from Hand of Guldan for each stack of Demonic Persistence on your Summoned Demon.
[Pending Restart] - Empowered Imp, Demonic Tactics, and Unholy Power Mystic Enchantments will now also affect your Wild Imps.

0.description: [Requires Restart] Fixed an issue where Felforged POIs will stay on the Twisting Nether map after they have left
[Requires Restart] Fixed Missing loot on King Voras in the Twisting Nether
[Requires Restart] Added Greedy Demons to the Twisting Nether
[Requires Restart] Titan Scrolls are no longer active in the Twisting Nether

[Pending Restart] - Fixed an issue with Arena Decay not decaying on its intended cycle. Every Arena Team has been set to atleast 1 active game played this week and thus will decay 2 weeks from now if no games are played and their rating is above 2200.

1.description: [Pending Restart] - Corrupted Bear Form now deals an additional 10% less damage with Shadow Bolts to players.
[Pending Restart] - Corrected an issue where the negative PvP mod on Nightfall and Backlash would apply at the same time despite only consuming one proc.
[Pending Restart] - Corrected an issue where the damage increase from Nightfall and Backlash would apply at the same time despite only consuming one proc.
[Pending Restart] - Corrected a recent issue where Nightfall and Backlash was being consumed simultaneously from one cast.
[Pending Restart] - Fixed an issue where Backlash was not increasing the damage of Incinerate against monsters nor decreasing the damage versus players.
[Pending Restart] - Fixed an exploit where having Backlash and Nightfall active at the same time would cause you to not consume your backlash procs.

0.description: [Honor Gear Improvements] - Matched the previous season honor cost of gear to those in the Classic PvP Progression. Most Items Honor Cost has been reduced by 25 to upwards of 40%.
[Honor Gear Improvements] - You can now purchase Previous Season Weapons With Honor.
[Honor Gear Improvements] - You can no longer purchase previous season arena gear for a mix of Honor and Arena Points. Since Arena Points are limited, this often caused regression in the long-term.
[Pending Restart] - Fixed an issue where some quests were giving less XP than intended past level 60.
Beginning to experiment with Dynamic POIs on players with Felforged. Felforged may begin showing on the map as POIs
Felforged: Silas Darkmoon now sits besides the Fel Portal, to make it more apparent where Fel Power is spent!
Felforged Tome: Journeyman Riding will now be granted when you reach 25000 Fel Power automatically.
Felforged Tome: Apprentice Riding will now be granted when you reach 5000 Fel Power automatically

[Requires Restart] The Felforged Caches you received based off of the level you died will now have an increasingly higher chance to give you Specific Mystic Scroll drops allowing you to enchant your items.
Buffed many Felforged Perks. See descriptions for details!
Improved the Meteors for Hillsbrad and Stranglethorn Vale to allow you to get to hillsbrad fields and kurzen compound.
Fixed phasing issues around Ashenvale that caused some bad pvp action.
Empower Legion Insignia is now upgraded and granted for Felforged automatically during Fel Power progression
Fixed an issue where Felforged Insignias were able to be double equip
[Requires Restart] Felforged will now get Mystic Runes and Mystic Orbs on death based on the level they reached.

1.description: [Pending restart] Fixed an issue where Hand of Gul'dan would not consume charges of Molten Core (rank 2).
[Pending restart] Fixed an issue where the capstone of Nemesis would only trigger once per Metamorphosis cast.
